title: 第25章 云大忽悠杳杳第26章 四师兄重伤
slug: 满级师妹她缺德但能打
content_zh:
三位闭关老祖的出世，如同定海神针，瞬间扭转了战局。
那浩瀚如海的纯正道家法力，携带着涤荡妖氛、净化魔气的无上伟力，顷刻间便将侵入宗门的魔云妖气驱散大半。
为首的那名元婴魔修见势不妙，厉啸一声，毫不犹豫地化作一道黑虹遁走，其余魔修妖族更是兵败如山倒，仓皇逃窜。
青云宗弟子士气大振，在各峰长老的带领下乘胜追击，清剿残余敌人。
高空中的激战也渐趋平息，来袭的元婴期魔君妖王见事不可为，纷纷虚晃一招，脱离战团，遁入虚空消失不见。
一场突如其来的浩劫，终于渐渐落下帷幕。
阳光重新洒落，却照不尽满目疮痍。
断壁残垣，焦土血迹，哀嚎的伤员，无声的遗体…昔日仙家福地，此刻宛如修罗场。
劫后余生的弟子们相拥而泣，既有活下来的庆幸，也有失去同门的悲恸。
云杳杳在石猛和匆匆赶回的炎铮护卫下，回到了相对安全的区域。
顾沧溟也收剑归来，冷峻的脸上带着一丝疲惫，目光扫过云杳杳，见她虽脸色苍白但气息尚稳，微不可察地点了点头。
很快，执法长老严正带着几位执事弟子赶来，面色凝重地看着云杳杳：“云师侄，你伤势如何？方才情况危急，你力战不退，救下众多同门，宗门感念。
只是…”
他话锋一转，目光锐利起来，“你所用之力，似乎并非本门功法，且…颇为诡异，那些魔修伤口尽成飞灰，此等力量闻所未闻，还请师侄解惑。”
顿时，周围几位长老和真传弟子的目光都聚焦在云杳杳身上，带着探究与疑虑。
方才战场混乱，但云杳杳那诡异的手段和造成的恐怖效果，实在太过醒目，想不引人注意都难。
炎铮立刻挡在云杳杳身前，梗着脖子道：“严长老！
你什么意思？我小师妹拼死杀敌，还有错了？那肯定是师尊给的保命底牌！”
石猛也沉声道：“若非师妹手段特殊，恐难以震慑群魔，支撑到救援。”
顾沧溟虽未说话，但冰冷的目光也看向了严正。

云杳杳心中暗叹，该来的总会来。
她早就料到会被追问。
幸好，她早有准备。
她脸上露出一丝恰到好处的后怕与疲惫，轻轻推开挡在身前的炎铮，声音略显虚弱道：“师兄，严长老问得在理。”
她抬起手，露出手腕上那个不起眼的、带有黑色玄奥纹路的镯子——这正是道衍真君当初给她的那枚储物戒幻化而成的形态。
“师尊赐予此镯时曾言，其中蕴含他老人家炼制的一丝‘寂灭玄罡’，威力极大却也凶险异常，嘱我非生死关头不可动用。
方才情急之下，弟子只好引动其中一丝力量…没想到…反噬如此之大…”
她说着，咳嗽了几声，嘴角又溢出些许血丝（一半是真伤，一半是逼出来的），脸色更加苍白，一副灵力透支、遭受反噬的模样。
与此同时，她神识微动，悄然引导着一丝混沌之力，模拟出一种霸道、寂灭、仿佛能湮灭万物的气息，小心翼翼地附着在那镯子之上，使其散发出微弱的、令人心悸的波动。
严正长老目光如电，仔细探查那镯子，果然感受到一股极其隐晦却无比恐怖的寂灭气息，与他刚才感知到的、战场上那湮灭魔修的力量属性隐隐吻合！
而且这气息深不可测，远超他的理解范畴，说是宗主所留，完全可信！
他再看向云杳杳那虚弱不堪、灵力紊乱的模样，确实是动用远超自身修为力量后遭受反噬的典型症状。
心中的疑虑顿时消去了七八分。
其他长老也用神识探查后，纷纷露出释然和敬畏之色。
原来是宗主留下的后手！
那就说得通了！
content_en:
The appearance of the three secluded ancestors was like a needle that fixed the sea, instantly turning the tide of the war.
The pure Taoist magic power, as vast as the sea, carries the supreme power to wash away the demonic atmosphere and purify the demonic aura. It can dispel most of the demonic cloud and demonic aura that invaded the sect in an instant.
Seeing that the situation was not good, the leader of the Nascent Soul Demon Cultivator let out a sharp roar and turned into a black rainbow without hesitation to escape. The rest of the Demon Cultivators were even more defeated and fled in panic.
The morale of the disciples of Qingyun Sect was greatly boosted. Under the leadership of the elders of each peak, they took advantage of the victory to pursue and eliminate the remaining enemies.
The fierce battle in the sky also gradually subsided. Seeing that they were unable to do anything, the incoming Nascent Soul Stage Demon Lords and Demon Kings made feints one after another, broke away from the battle group, escaped into the void and disappeared.
A sudden catastrophe finally came to an end.
The sun shines again, but it cannot illuminate the devastation everywhere.
Broken walls, scorched earth and bloodstains, wailing wounded, silent remains... the former paradise of the immortal family is now like a Shura field.
The disciples who survived the disaster hugged each other and cried, feeling both lucky to have survived and sad to have lost their fellow disciples.
Yun Yaoyao returned to a relatively safe area under the protection of Shi Meng and Yan Zheng who hurried back.
Gu Cangming also put away his sword and returned with a hint of exhaustion on his stern face. He glanced at Yun Yaoyao and saw that although her face was pale, her breath was still stable, and he nodded imperceptibly.
Soon, the law enforcement elder Yan Zheng came over with several deacon disciples, and looked at Yun Yaoyao solemnly: "Senior nephew Yun, how are you injured? The situation was critical just now, but you fought hard and saved many of your fellow disciples. The sect is grateful.
Just..."
He changed the topic and his eyes sharpened, "The power you used does not seem to be from my own technique, and... it is quite strange. The wounds of those demon cultivators were all reduced to fly ash. This kind of power is unheard of. I ask my nephew to clarify my doubts."
Suddenly, the eyes of several elders and true disciples around him were focused on Yun Yaoyao, with inquiry and doubts.
The battlefield was chaotic just now, but Yun Yaoyao's strange methods and the terrifying effects were so eye-catching that it was difficult not to attract attention.
Yan Zheng immediately stood in front of Yun Yaoyao, holding his neck and said: "Elder Yan!
What do you mean? My little junior sister fought tooth and nail to kill the enemy. Is there anything wrong? That must be the life-saving trump card given by Master! "
Shi Meng also said in a deep voice: "If it weren't for the special skills of Junior Sister, it might be difficult to frighten the demons and support the rescue."
Although Gu Cangming said nothing, he looked at Yan Zheng with cold eyes.
Yun Yaoyao sighed in his heart, what should come will always come.
She had expected to be questioned.
Fortunately, she was prepared.
There was just the right amount of fear and exhaustion on her face. She gently pushed Yan Zheng away and said in a slightly weak voice, "Brother, Elder Yan is right to ask."
She raised her hand, revealing the inconspicuous bracelet with black mysterious patterns on her wrist - this was the transformed form of the storage ring given to her by Zhenjun Daoyan.
"When the master gave this bracelet to me, he said that it contained a trace of the 'Xuan Gang' refined by his old man. It was extremely powerful but also extremely dangerous. He told me not to use it unless it was a matter of life or death.
In desperation just now, the disciple had no choice but to activate some of the power... I didn't expect... the backlash would be so great..."
As she spoke, she coughed a few times, and some bloodshot eyes overflowed from the corners of her mouth (half from real injuries, half from forced injuries), her face became even paler, and she looked like her spiritual energy was exhausted and she was suffering from backlash.
At the same time, her consciousness moved slightly, quietly guiding a trace of the power of chaos, simulating a domineering, silent aura that seemed to be able to annihilate all things, and carefully attached it to the bracelet, causing it to emit weak, heart-stopping fluctuations.
Elder Yan Zheng's eyes were like lightning, and he carefully explored the bracelet, and sure enough, he felt an extremely obscure but extremely terrifying aura of annihilation, which was vaguely consistent with the power attributes of the Annihilation Demonic Cultivator on the battlefield that he had just sensed!
Moreover, this aura is unfathomable and far beyond his understanding. It is completely believable to say that it was left by the sect master!He then looked at Yun Yaoyao's weak and disordered appearance. It was indeed a typical symptom of suffering backlash after using power far beyond his own cultivation level.
The doubts in my heart immediately disappeared by seven or eight points.
The other elders also used their spiritual senses to investigate, and they all showed expressions of relief and awe.
It turned out to be a back-up left behind by the sect leader!
That makes sense!
